name: HB reward claim refills PROOF by pulling HB from the HB/USDT pair
summary: A PROOF reward claim (a plain call to the PROOF proxy from a registered wallet) calls MAIN.swapBack, which has HB.swapBack move up to 200,000 HB straight from the HB/USDT pair to PROOF and sync() whenever PROOF's balance is short. The attacker, an EIP-7702-delegated EOA that passes PROOF's msg.sender == tx.origin check inside its own flash-loan batch, bought the pair down to 200,000 HB for a whitelisted wallet, claimed a 612.83 HB reward so the refill took the pair's last 200,000 HB, and sold dust HB into the resulting 0.002 HB reserve for the pair's USDT.

loss.notes: Exact USDT depletion of the HB/USDT pair 0x67a63609cf1c317196724666cc39b2da63545a96 in the single exploit transaction. The 72.1M USDT buy and every later USDT deposit into the pair came from the Moolah WBNB flash loan and Venus borrows, all repaid within the transaction. The 73.6M HB bought for the whitelisted wallet and the 200,000 HB moved to PROOF are the same liquidity and are not added. About 1,510 USDT left in the pair was sold out by various holders over the next 14,000 blocks and is not counted.

ageReset.description: Owner upgradeTo selected the PROOF implementation whose wallet-triggered _claimReward sources rewards through MAIN.swapBack from the pair; it is the last Upgraded event before the exploit and the latest code activation among the executed HB, PROOF and MAIN artifacts.
Owner upgradeTo selected the HERMES implementation whose swapBack moves HB from the pair to PROOF and syncs; last Upgraded event before the exploit.

limitations: Not the knot: this HB implementation was activated at 88802075, 16 blocks before the PROOF implementation that completed the claim-triggered pull.

sources.note: Lead from BlockSec (source-8), which cites the HERMES implementation; the HB token is proxy 0x86ddbfc6f2e3cf096e80ca79e46042392bd90aef. source-1: 91158398:1, EOA 0x2e358f7e323b9e615231873f17b099b833163f23 (eth_getCode at 91158397 = 0xef0100 7f49343d19d2dfdf4b6d2943e2e613e7ef2428ac, an EIP-7702 delegation; registered in PROOF by a 0.4 BNB stake at 90955945) calls attack contract 0x4acaf8388c97def668e0c3b01e3d18260c6a8f1a (created 91156825). debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) and receipt: Moolah WBNB flash loan and Venus borrows; 1496.816 HB to the token (log 13) and a dust sell that makes it swap 4163.99 HB (log 16); router buy of 72117360.5386 USDT into pair 0x67a63609cf1c317196724666cc39b2da63545a96 delivering 73608753.069826942998775352 HB to whitelisted recieve wallet 0x55a6e574f68e567a43153831f0394d8c71ca4a45 (log 35; non-whitelisted buys revert or burn in _handleBuy), leaving reserves 72312818.46 USDT / 200000.002 HB (sync log 36). The attack contract then has the EOA (7702 execute 0xb61d27f6) CALL PROOF proxy 0x5b41af6a9b314ef4d92f6809087740a83d20570a with empty calldata, so msg.sender == tx.origin holds; PROOF fallback -> _handleETH(0) -> _claimReward: MAIN 0xcc9dadc6c290f9e12a9805a005aaf3c37f46fdb5 claimReward 0xd279c191 returns 612.830688157590440468 HB, PROOF calls MAIN.swapBack 0xc1ebb47b(612.83e18), MAIN calls HB.swapBack(200462.103766722745490130e18) = PROOF balance 462.103766722745490130 + 200000, and HB moves 200000 HB pair->PROOF (log 38) and syncs (log 39: HB reserve 2000000000000000 wei); PROOF pays the 612.83 HB reward (log 40). The attack contract then alternates USDT deposits and dust HB sells into the 0.002 HB reserve (logs 46-193) and sends 193936.992854217695184451 USDT to the EOA (log 205). Verified sources (source-4): HERMES.swapBack(amount) requires msg.sender == MAIN and transfers min(amount - PROOF balance, pair balance) from the pair to PROOF, then pair.sync(); PROOF._claimReward calls _MAIN.swapBack(totalReward) (and swapBack(maxTeamNeed)) before paying, reachable from receive()/fallback() by any registered wallet, and its tx.origin check does not stop a 7702-delegated EOA from batching the claim with the buy and sells. MAIN implementation 0xcb0cfe74b43d769215b3f6aef046b4a9b358e0d4 is unverified; its forwarding of a 200000 HB top-up is observed only in the trace; its implementation was activated at 88222176:79:291 (source-7), before both others, so it cannot be the knot.
